Build a complete FC/NES 8-bit style Tank Battle game using pure Canvas API with zero external assets. The project is greenfield — no source files exist. All 18+ source files must be created from scratch, including a pixel sprite system (16×16 matrices with palette indices), animation engine, game logic (tanks, bullets, terrain, collision), UI system with pixel fonts, and visual effects. The game renders at 512×480 with 3× scaled sprites and targets 60 FPS using Bun as the build tool.
